Is your feature request related to an existing problem or limitation? Explain what you're trying to do and why the current experience doesn't meet your needs.

**Describe the feature**

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see in Riflay. Explain how you expect it to work.

**Feature category**

Select the category that best describes your request:

- [ ] Playback & Queue
- [ ] Audio Quality & DSP
- [ ] Library & Playlists
- [ ] Lyrics & Visuals
- [ ] UI/UX & Customization
- [ ] Integration & Connectivity
- [ ] Performance & Optimization
- [ ] Other

**Target platform**

Select all platforms where you'd like this feature:

- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Android
- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Web
- [ ] All platforms

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Have you tried any workarounds or alternative solutions? If so, briefly describe them. *(Optional)*

**Additional context**

Add any screenshots, mockups, examples from other music players, or other details that could help explain your request. *(Optional)*
